Agency: Department of Transportation

Description of Services to be Provided: Engineering Service Agreement (ESA) for Resident Engineering and Inspection Services, Citywide (HBESA27A and HBESA27B) This new procurement for ESA Services will provide resident engineering and construction inspection services including construction supervision, contract compliance monitoring, daily reporting, material testing, safety oversight, constructability reviews, and evaluation of proposed changes and value engineering options. Services will also include public outreach and communications, preparation of final as-built drawings and payment packages, project closeout documentation, audit support, and other resident engineering services as specified in individual assignments.

Anticipated New Start Date: 12/3/2027

Anticipated New End Date: 12/2/2030

Anticipated Procurement Method: Request for Proposal

Job Titles: None

Headcounts: 0

 

Agency: Department of Transportation

Description of Services to be Provided: Engineering Service Agreement (ESA) for Design Services, Citywide (HBESA27C and HBESA27D)

This new procurement for ESA Services will provide total design and construction support services including land surveying, inspections, street and highway design, bridge engineering, traffic engineering, geotechnical investigations and analysis, environmental assessments and reporting, permit acquisition and regulatory approvals, community outreach and presentations, preparation of contract plans, schedules, and estimates, bid analysis, contract document interpretation, shop drawing review, value engineering, and other design services as specified in individual assignments.
